# Cornelia Bryant

[Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative)

## Overview

- **Age:** 59 (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXVI. MISS CORNELIA GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW P26](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0026)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P17](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0017)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Cornelia Bryant features a fresh, round, pink-and-white face complemented by jolly brown eyes. Her fair hair is styled into a hard little knob that is secured tightly with an elastic band.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)_

## Personality

Cornelia Bryant possesses a sharp, bitter tongue alongside a remarkably kind heart, though she is known as an inveterate man-hater who is constantly critical of and abusive toward men. Despite her outspoken nature and strong opinions, she considers herself a lonely soul and is noted for being particularly cracked on the subject of [Methodists](../codex/factions.md#methodist). She is highly skilled in needlework, recognized as the finest sewer in her area, and performs exquisite embroidery. Additionally, she harbors a fear that [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) might poison the minds of the manse children.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P22](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), +5 more_

## History

Cornelia Bryant was frequent guest at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's home in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), often sharing her sharp opinions on local men, religion, and town news. After learning the tragic history of [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), she encouraged [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to be a persistent friend to her. When [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) suggested sending Leslie's brain-damaged husband, [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md), to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for a medical evaluation, Cornelia initially confronted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in anger, though she ultimately accepted the plan. She was utterly shocked when the surgery revealed that [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) was actually his cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), which freed [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) from her tragic marriage. Later, Cornelia surprised her friends by revealing her intention to marry [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), and she subsequently became Mrs. Marshall Elliott. Years later, after returning from a trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), Cornelia caught up with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) to discuss the new minister, Mr. Meredith, and his motherless children. Upon learning that Mary Vance's abusive former guardian had died, Cornelia was approached by [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) and agreed to adopt Mary after consulting with Marshall. Despite occasionally expressing dismay over the Meredith children's scandals, Cornelia was swayed by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to take pride in the minister's family, and she continued to visit [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) to gossip about town affairs and upcoming weddings.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P2](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P3](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P5](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P6](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P8](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0008), +84 more_

## Quotes

> “I am sure I hope so,” said Miss Cornelia, none too hopefully. “But speaking of the devil, I am positive that Billy Booth is possessed by him now. Have you heard of Billy’s latest performance?”
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P42](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0042)

> “This has been an awful disappointment to me,” sighed Miss Cornelia. “I’ve looked forward to this baby—and I did want it to be a girl, too.”
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P25](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0025)

> "You always look as cool as a cucumber, Anne, dearie. Do I smell cherry pie? If I do, ask me to stay to tea. Haven’t tasted a cherry pie this summer. My cherries have all been stolen by those scamps of Gilman boys from the Glen."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P12](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0012)

> "There’s a great change come over her lately. She laughs and jokes like a girl, and from her talk I gather she’s here real often."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025)

> "Anne, do you mean to tell me it’s true what I’ve heard—that Dr. Blythe has told Leslie Dick can be cured, and that she is going to take him to Montreal to have him operated on?"
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--cornelia-bryant.md)

Miss Cornelia Bryant is a visiting neighbor and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She frequently visits Anne's home to sew for needy families, discuss local townspeople, and share her outspoken views on religion, marriage, and men. She also recounts local histories to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and encourages her to offer friendship to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md).

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--leslie-moore.md)

Miss Cornelia acts as a friend and protector to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), sharing her tragic background with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and helping manage her affairs, such as bringing boarder [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) to her house.
